feats.title: Bloody Balance
feats.description: While you are adjacent to a bloodied ally, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls.

feats.title: In Shining Armor
feats.description: While you are wearing plate armor and using a shield, adjacent allies gain a +1 shield bonus to AC if you are conscious.

feats.title: Virtuous Recovery
feats.description: Whenever you spend a healing surge, you gain resistance to all damage equal to your Wisdom until the start of your next turn.

feats.title: Divinity’s Shield
feats.description: When you use a channel divinity power, you gain a +2 bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will defenses until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Mercy’s Reward
feats.description: When you score a critical hit, you can choose to reduce it to a normal hit instead. If you do, you or one ally adjacent to you can spend a healing surge and regain 10 additional hit points.

feats.title: Bitter Challenge
feats.description: Whenever a target takes damage from your divine challenge, it is also slowed until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Mighty Challenge
feats.description: Whenever a target of your divine challenge takes damage from that power, it takes extra radiant damage equal to your Strength.

feats.title: Mettle Proven
feats.description: When an ally succeeds on a saving throw granted by your use of divine mettle, the ally can spend a healing surge.

feats.title: Sudden Smite
feats.description: When you hit with an attack, you can use divine strength as a free action and apply its damage bonus to the triggering hit instead of your next attack.

feats.title: Lend Health
feats.description: Whenever you use a power that allows an ally to spend a healing surge or regain hit points as if he or she had spent a healing surge, that ally can use your healing surge value to determine the number of hit points regained.

feats.title: Devoted Templar
feats.description: When you use your lay on hands on an ally, that ally regains additional hit points equal to your Charisma. Your number of healing surges increases by one.

feats.title: Healing Hands
feats.description: When you use the lay on hands power, the affected ally gains additional hit points equal to your Charisma.
